transcript.text: Thanks for making the time, Jordan. I want to leave this call with a clear scope and a start date for the follow-up system.
Perfect. Right now enquiries come in through the website form and by phone, and we log them by hand. We get around forty a week and only a third are answered the same day.
Where does the data live once it is logged? If the CRM export is messy we will need a week to clean it before we automate anything.
It is messy, honestly. Duplicates, missing phone numbers, the lot. I can send you an export today.
Then here is what I suggest. We start with the enquiry form only: an instant reply, a qualifying question, and a booking link. WhatsApp comes in phase two.
Agreed. Anything over five thousand pounds should go to a person, not a bot.
I will send the proposal and the onboarding form by Friday. Priya will audit the export and tell you which fields need cleaning.
And someone needs to book the kickoff call for the week after next once the proposal is signed.
I will share admin access to the form this afternoon. Thanks both.

## Meeting Purpose

[To agree the scope and start date for Northwind Studio's lead follow-up system.](https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-sample-not-a-real-recording?timestamp=12.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Scope agreed:** Northwind wants every new enquiry answered within five minutes, with a human handover for anything over 5,000 pounds.](https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-sample-not-a-real-recording?timestamp=95.0)
  - [**Biggest risk:** their CRM export is messy, so the first week goes on cleaning data before anything is automated.](https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-sample-not-a-real-recording?timestamp=310.0)
  - [**Decision:** start with the enquiry form only and add WhatsApp in phase two.](https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-sample-not-a-real-recording?timestamp=642.0)

## Topics

### Current process

  - Enquiries arrive by form and by phone and are logged by hand.
      - Around 40 a week, a third answered the same day.
  - Jordan checks the inbox twice a day.

### Proposed build

1. Form submission triggers an instant reply.
2. Qualified leads are booked straight into the calendar.

## Next Steps

  - Sam to send the proposal and the onboarding form by Friday.
  - Priya to audit the CRM export and list the fields that need cleaning.
  - Jordan to share admin access to the enquiry form.
